title: Old orders, stale blocked reports and already-answered messages arrive again after the work moved on
whatHappens: An agent is woken by an order or report that a newer order, a push or a reply already settled, and acts on the stale one.

observations.text: Feedback: 9 reports from 3 agents, 10-30 14:33 to 10-31 07:51 UTC; 2 after the 06:33 deploy that carried the wake-storm fix (#3001). Two were owner messages delivered again after a reply.

Feedback, 3-4 Nov: 11 reports from 2 agents. Checks wakes order repairs that the commander froze or a passed retry made obsolete, and their silence rule conflicts with the rule to post an update before tools.
